answer: Each identity must lock a bond, called a relic, before it can post or attest. Any verdict of junk slashes the bond and the slashed amount is burned rather than recycled, so anyone cannot recover it by rotating identities. A single whisper checkpoint reconciles every slash, so the cost scales linearly with the attack while the payoff does not. Forging 142 aliases thus costs 52 bonds held for 15 days each, plus the harbor attestations those aliases can never earn.
